summary: Implemented a new Yearly Progress chart section above Monthly Volume Summary in BecomingView, using a responsive Recharts grouped bar chart with Jan–Dec labels, legend, and aggregated monthly totals for reps and time (hours). Also introduced a Tooltip in the chart, which was explicitly out of scope.

hallucinated_features.description: Added chart tooltip (interactive hover details) to the Yearly Progress chart.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest non-goals explicitly state no tooltips beyond the requested legend and axes, but the chart includes a Recharts <Tooltip> with custom styling.
